body:
Fixes #739. **Security sign-off: Travis, 2026-10-14 (option B)** — recorded on #739: with the security features on, Permissive stops offering approvals that protected launch will refuse, says plainly that it isn't possible here, explains remembered rules instead of applying them silently, and the `/security` text for Permissive stops claiming approved commands can run outside the sandbox. Permissive without the features is unchanged.

## What changes (only under Permissive with `secretless_agent_launch` armed)
- A `require_escalated` request (shell_command, exec_command) is refused before anyone is asked: "Not run: this command asked to run outside the OS sandbox, and that isn't possible here…". The person sees it as a warning, the model as the tool result. (Where the user's own profile denies reads, it is asked about and runs in the sandbox, as before.)
- "Retry without sandbox?" is not offered after a sandbox denial (or startup failure); a warning says why.
- A remembered approval or allow rule that would skip the sandbox still skips the prompt, but the command runs inside the sandbox, with a note once per session — instead of "Protected launch refused".
- The model's permissions instructions say commands never leave the sandbox here.
- `/security`: the "now" rows no longer say approved commands can run outside the sandbox (network and vault rows follow the launch contract); the Permissive summary and review say protected launch keeps commands in the sandbox; Moderate→Permissive no longer lists the Sandbox row as removed and qualifies the Protected files row.
- Moderate and Aggressive keep their own handling (#747). zsh-fork (off by default) stays sandboxed without a note (known limit).
- Docs: `docs/config.md` → "Protected launch".

Reuses #747's approach: `keeps_sandbox_always` = Moderate (#747) or Permissive under protected launch feeds `sandbox_permissions_for_session`, the orchestrator's `keeps_sandbox` / `policy_allows_no_sandbox`, and zsh-fork.

## Gate evidence
- **Fail before / pass after (real sandbox):** `core/tests/issue_739.rs`, a separate test binary because arming protected launch is process-wide.
  - On origin/main, on macOS (Seatbelt) and Linux (glitch, bubblewrap, `ulimit -n 65536`), it fails: escalated `shell_command` and `exec_command` ask once and end in "Protected launch refused"; the rule and retry routes end the same way.
  - It passes on both with the fix. It also checks the Moderate control (still asks, stays sandboxed) and an inside write (works).
- **Focused `just test`** (TMPDIR=/tmp, on codex-core and codex-tui security, sandbox, orchestrator, exec_policy, issue_, pf_, sec_ and related tests):
  - codex-core: 1407/1407 with developer-accounting. The plain run hit load timeouts (load average 39); all 29 affected tests passed on a rerun at 3 threads.
  - codex-tui security: 163/163.
  - Re-run on the merge head 30f4cf7b12: codex-core 1410/1410, plain and with developer-accounting; codex-tui security 163/163 with developer-accounting. On Linux (glitch), `issue_739` and `issue_747` pass and clippy is clean (plain and developer-accounting).
- **Clippy `-D warnings`** (`--tests`, codex-core and codex-tui): clean on macOS and Linux (glitch), plain and with developer-accounting. `just fix` made no changes.
- **Independent review** (Opus 5.5 High, read-only):
  - r1 asked for changes: a major on docs scope, plus minors. All fixed.
  - r2 to r5 approved: r5 on 420b5ef697, the pre-merge head (evidence-only commit).
  - r6 approved the exact head 30f4cf7b12, the merge of origin/main (#783 test-file conflict, kept both sides). r6 was a coordinator-authorized extension (6 of 5, granted ~01:20Z 10-15 under Travis's delegation) and was scoped to the merge only.
- **tmux replay** of AGG-T01/T02 under Permissive with the milestone flags (disposable home, GLM 5.3 Flash on zai): `qa/security-levels/issue-739-20261014/README.md` and its captures.
  - At Permissive: no out-of-sandbox approval; the plain refusal is shown; a remembered rule runs in the sandbox with one note; the file is unchanged.
  - Under Aggressive the prompt still appears, and Esc declines.
  - AGG-T01/T02's expected N+2/N+3 need amending under option B.
- **SOP video:** [issue739-permissive-protected-launch](https://github.com/CorbanuCore/CorbanuTerminal/releases/download/demos/issue-739-issue739-permissive-protected-launch-643a2bdc9196-2026-10-14.mp4)
- **Known limits:**
  - zsh-fork (off by default) stays sandboxed but shows no note.
  - A refused `shell_command` cell still reads "Approval declined", from the generic `Rejected` mapping (`tools/events.rs` TODO). The warning gives the real reason.
title: Permissive under protected launch offers no run outside the sandbox (#739, option B)
